subject: CStreamingInfo -- per-asset streaming metadata record
_note: Backfilled into RE-Data JSON from the C2.2 chapter prose (which was the only machine-unreadable home for this, the most-cited struct in the project -- see SASDK-READINESS-REPORT.md S5). Layout proven cold in the C2.2 disassembly; the three 0x04/0x07/0x08 fields were marked reasoned there and subsequently confirmed by disassembly.

fields.name: m_nNextIndex
fields.note: eviction-list forward link; 16-bit index (0xFFFF = null), spliced in RequestModel unlink sequence

fields.name: m_nNextIndexOnCd
fields.note: load-order chain; reasoned in C2.2, Closed in X1 S3.1 (confirmed)

fields.name: m_nFlags
fields.note: request flags; accumulated via OR (not replaced). bit 0x10 = priority

fields.name: m_nImgId
fields.note: archive (IMG) index; reasoned in C2.2, Closed in X1 S3.1 (confirmed)

fields.name: m_nCdPosn
fields.note: packed sector handle / offset; reasoned in C2.2, Closed in X1 S3.1 (confirmed)

fields.name: m_nCdSize
fields.note: size in 2048-byte sectors; shl 0xB at accounting site is the sector->byte seam

fields.name: m_nLoadState
fields.note: load state 0/1/2; 116 references -- the most-read field in the subsystem

fields.name: _pad
fields.note: tail padding to 4-byte alignment; the struct's only slack byte range
